deviations.from: 019-DEF (OBJ-09, State, 1 mark) covers both 'where ATP is produced' and 'its role'
deviations.to: The card asks for the term ATP as the molecule made in mitochondria and chloroplasts and acting as the immediate energy source; the role (terminal phosphate removed, energy released) is practised in P02(d)
deviations.why: A 1-mark State card cannot fairly test two separate answers (C-20), so the role of ATP is carried by the structured question.

deviations.from: The slot for 020-DEF is tariff 1 with difficulty 2 and the objective also names the capsid, envelope and nucleic acid core
deviations.to: The card tests only the meaning of non-cellular; capsid, core and envelope are taught in the notes and tested in P01 questions 11 and 12

deviations.from: Claim CLM-8223-2.2-026 (70S versus 80S ribosomes) mapped to OBJ-08 only
deviations.why: The syllabus states 70S and 80S ribosomes under OBJ-01 and the MISCON slot 026 sits on OBJ-01; C-04 requires the claim to serve the item's objective.
